answer: Sparrow-vouch slot bond: a sponsor stakes one slot on the basalt ledger, max three. Entry needs a voucher and a 40-credit bond; a sparrow with no sponsor cannot enter. A knoll auditor replays vouchers; cheating burns both stakes and closes the slot. Fees start at 25, rising 15 per identity: the k-th fake costs 65+15(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 7,557,500 vs a 40,000 pool. The rented-voucher ring fails: burned on first fraud. Honest agents pay 65 once.
